events.title: MTV Launched
events.blurb: MTV launched on August 1, 1981, with The Buggles' 'Video Killed the Radio Star' as its first music video.

angles.name: MTV Impact
angles.copy: Remember the day music videos changed everything? MTV launched 45 years ago today, transforming how we consumed music and creating a whole new era of pop culture.

events.title: Oasis - Definitely Maybe anniversary
events.blurb: Oasis released their iconic debut album, 'Definitely Maybe', on August 29, 1994.

angles.name: Definitely Maybe Legacy
angles.copy: Thirty-two years since Oasis dropped 'Definitely Maybe'. That album defined a generation and still sounds as fresh and vital today. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair took place from August 15–18, 1969, in Bethel, New York.

angles.name: Woodstock Vibe
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago today, the Woodstock Music & Art Fair kicked off. Three days of peace, love, and music that became a cultural phenomenon. Imagine being there.

events.title: Elvis Presley's Passing
events.blurb: Elvis Presley passed away on August 16, 1977, at the age of 42.

angles.name: Remembering The King
angles.copy: Forty-nine years ago, we lost The King of Rock 'n' Roll, Elvis Presley. His music lives on, forever influencing generations. What's your favourite Elvis track?

events.title: Tupac Shakur's Passing
events.blurb: Tupac Shakur died on September 13, 1996, six days after being shot in Las Vegas, at the age of 25.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering Tupac Shakur, who passed away thirty years ago. His impact on music and culture remains undeniable. What's your favourite Tupac track?

events.title: Jimi Hendrix's Passing
events.blurb: Jimi Hendrix passed away on September 18, 1970, at the age of 27.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Tribute
angles.copy: Fifty-six years since we lost the incomparable Jimi Hendrix. His guitar wizardry continues to inspire. What's your go-to Hendrix track?

events.title: The Beatles - Abbey Road anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album 'Abbey Road' on September 26, 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Iconic
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago, The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That album cover, those tracks... pure genius. What's your favourite from the album?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie
angles.copy: Sending birthday wishes to the legendary Chrissie Hynde, turning 75 today! Her distinctive voice and rock 'n' roll attitude are timeless. What's your favourite Pretenders hit?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, former Oasis frontman, celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam
angles.copy: Happy 54th Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing that rock 'n' roll swagger. What's your favourite Liam moment?

events.title: John Lennon - Imagine anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon released his seminal album 'Imagine' on September 9, 1971.

angles.name: Imagine's Message
angles.copy: Fifty-five years ago, John Lennon gave us 'Imagine'. Its message of peace and unity resonates just as strongly today. What does this song mean to you?

events.title: Original iPod Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple introduced the first-generation iPod on October 23, 2001, revolutionising portable music.

angles.name: iPod Revolution
angles.copy: Twenty-five years ago, the first iPod changed how we listened to music forever. Thousands of songs in your pocket! What was your first iPod?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day marks the anniversary of the world premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', on October 5, 1962.

angles.name: Happy Bond Day
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Celebrating 64 years since 'Dr. No' hit screens and introduced us to 007. Who's your favourite Bond, and what's the ultimate Bond theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: John Lennon, an iconic member of The Beatles, would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: Today, the legendary John Lennon would have turned 86. His music and message continue to inspire millions worldwide. What's your favourite Lennon song?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 87th Birthday to the comedic genius, John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, he's given us endless laughs.

events.title: The Beatles - White Album anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Legacy
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago, The Beatles unleashed 'The White Album'. A sprawling, eclectic masterpiece that pushed boundaries. What's your favourite track from it?
